title: Erlang/OTP kernel Source (curated selection)
licence_verified_from: erlang/otp LICENSE.txt, read via GitHub connector (full Apache 2.0 text)
notes: Curated real Erlang teaching the runtime-facing kernel: applications, code loading, file I/O, logger, OS interaction, rpc, global name registration, distribution (net_kernel, dist_util, auth, erl_boot_server), TCP/UDP sockets, error_logger. Code unmodified. Left out for the ~1.1M budget: inet.erl (174k), socket.erl (284k), gen_tcp_socket/gen_udp_socket, disk_log, global_group, application_controller, trace, group, prim_tty, and the rest of lib/kernel/src (104 .erl files total).
